title: The alert evaluator keys its terminal stops on the phase alone
description:
stopsFromStatusDoc (cloudflare/src/notify.ts) reads doc.lifecycle.phase alone for its terminal stops: phase 'done' pages done, phase 'failed' pages failed. It cannot produce c65's false done (done requires the phase explicitly), but a run whose liveness answer carries the durable end word (completed/stopped/failed) while its phase is stale pages nothing, where the chip — after c65 — classes the same doc failed/done with a resume. Whether the alert evaluator should read the same durable word (and what, if anything, a deliberately stopped run should page) is a decision worth its own tick; the two halves of the terminal classification can otherwise drift.
evidence: cloudflare/src/notify.ts:88-110 (stopsFromStatusDoc's liveness-alive branch switches on doc.lifecycle.phase only); the dashboard_stopped golden produces zero stops while classifyStatusDoc now reads cancelled
